description: This file defines a Smarty plugin for formatting dates. It includes a function smarty_modifier_date_format that takes a date string and formats it according to specified options, utilizing the shared make_timestamp plugin. The code handles special cases for Windows systems to adapt date formats.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_date_format
methods.description: Formats a date string into a specified strftime format, with handling for Windows-specific date format conversions.
